invariant: A pages-scoped API key may only access the /v1/pages/* namespace, never the /v1/users/* or /v1/search namespaces.
mutation: GET /v1/pages/%2e%2e/users/me with a pages-scoped token (path-normalization endpoint confusion)
expected_safe: 401/403 — the pages-scoped token is rejected outside the /v1/pages/* namespace
violation_signal: 200 OK with the victim's identity (id/name/email) in the response body
minimum_confirmation: Cross-actor response contains the controlled victim marker F2-MARKER-7 AND ownership identity verified as the victim's (not just a 200).
disconfirming_controls: Response is not cached (Cache-Control: no-store); the token is genuinely pages-scoped (no users:read capability).
